title: Grade 5 9.08
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Apply simple probability | Calculate simple probabilities | Find probability from a set | Calculate probabilities | Express probability as fractions | Calculate probability | Find probability from groups | Apply probability concepts | Identify certain events | Identify impossible events | Compare likelihoods | Compare probabilities | Identify equal probabilities | Calculate probabilities of events | Calculate event probabilities | Solve probability problems | Solve multi-category probability problems | Apply probability in real-world situations | Apply probability to real-life contexts
